C0.quote: We consider electoral control by deleting
C0.note: Studies electoral control by voter deletion under plurality when an LDP mechanism is used in pre-election polls.

C1.quote: the effect brought by local differential privacy in a voting system
C1.note: The main results quantify the attacker's control cost (SB), computed via ILP/LP bounds (AL). Section 5 runs numeric experiments on generated voting systems; one generation method samples true types from Sushi data, but the generated systems remain synthetic.

C2.1.quote: we define the type1 of his/her preference as the candidate he/she votes for

C2.2.quote: each voter votes for exactly one candidate
C2.2.note: Plurality: a single candidate per voter (the type in [1,m]).

C2.3.quote: the type of his/her preference is private information
C2.3.note: A true preference/true type is held, distinguished from the reported type used in polls.

C2.4.quote: Voters will vote according to their true types in the election.
C2.4.note: Only the reported type (for polls) differs from the held type. The vote that enters the rule is stated to equal the true type, with no reason given.

C3.1.quote: Voters will still vote according to their true preference
C3.1.note: The reported types arise from a randomized LDP mechanism, not from strategic choice, and they are not inputs to the rule.

C3.2.quote: Voters will still vote according to their true preference

C3.3.quote: Voters will vote according to their true types in the election.

C4.1.note: The input format is OTH (single-candidate vote), and no utility notions are used for voters.

C5.1.note: Results concern the attacker's manipulation cost, not welfare criteria.

VOT.quote_behav: Voters will vote according to their true types in the election.
VOT.note: Voters also run the LDP mechanism for polls, which is a fixed action.

ORG.quote_info: the attacker needs to delete voters according to reported types
ORG.note: The 'attacker' is the controlling agent (control by deleting voters). In the classical scenario it has complete information; in the LDP scenario it knows lambda and the reported types only. Coded PARTIAL for the main LDP analysis.
